critical_code_review_comments: reports.py kpi_overview: _kpi_cache is process-local and unbounded. With multiple gunicorn workers, cache-hit ratio will be lower than expected and admins on different workers may see slightly different snapshots for up to 120s. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.

kpi_overview cache key is (scope, today) — when a caller hits the endpoint their user id is used as scope which is correct, but multiple callers with reports permission would share the 'all' key. Currently callers are blocked so this is fine.

The conversion funnel uses tag_counts('OPD Done')['mtd'] which will match ANY section containing that sub-status; if 'OPD Done' appears in both Valid and Contacted/Converted stage mappings, its count is still a per-tag total (correct), but stage titles/rows may show the same label under multiple sections (already seen: OPD Done appears in Valid + Converted sections). Consider whether double-display is desirable.
